name: traveler-v1
chrf_floor_note: Calibrated from the NEU-61 kickoff sweep: measured corpus chrF 83.8 on the published v2.0.0 pack; floor = max(15.0, min(0.45 * chrF, chrF - 20)). A direction-mislabeled pack collapses far below this value (see the es-en adversarial control).

entries.source: Preciso de 3 bilhetes para amanhã de manhã.
entries.reference: I need 3 tickets for tomorrow morning.

entries.source: Somos 5 pessoas, incluindo 2 crianças.
entries.reference: There are 5 of us, including 2 children.

entries.source: O meu número de telefone é 0044 7788 123456.
entries.reference: My phone number is 0044 7788 123456.

entries.source: O voo demora 9 horas e 25 minutos.
entries.reference: The flight takes 9 hours and 25 minutes.

entries.source: Somos 4 pessoas e temos 6 malas.
entries.reference: We are 4 people and we have 6 suitcases.

entries.source: O quarto 214 fica no segundo andar.
entries.reference: Room 214 is on the second floor.

entries.source: Cheguei a 3 de outubro e parto a 9 de outubro.
entries.reference: I arrived on October 3 and I leave on October 9.

entries.source: A que horas abre o museu aos domingos?
entries.reference: What time does the museum open on Sundays?

entries.source: O meu comboio parte às 18:45 da plataforma 7.
entries.reference: My train leaves at 18:45 from platform 7.

entries.source: O último autocarro parte às 23:30 esta noite.
entries.reference: The last bus leaves at 23:30 tonight.

entries.source: Tenho uma reserva às 20h para 2 pessoas.
entries.reference: I have a reservation at 8 pm for 2 people.

entries.source: A farmácia abre antes das 9 da manhã?
entries.reference: Does the pharmacy open before 9 in the morning?

entries.source: A visita começa às 14:15 e dura 3 horas.
entries.reference: The tour starts at 14:15 and lasts 3 hours.

entries.source: O pequeno-almoço é servido das 6:30 às 10:00.
entries.reference: Breakfast is served from 6:30 to 10:00.

entries.source: Quanto custa um quarto duplo para 3 noites?
entries.reference: How much is a double room for 3 nights?

entries.source: Isto custa 45 euros, incluindo impostos.
entries.reference: This costs 45 euros, including tax.

entries.source: Há desconto para 2 adultos e 1 criança?
entries.reference: Is there a discount for 2 adults and 1 child?

entries.source: O bilhete custa 12,50 euros por pessoa.
entries.reference: The ticket costs 12.50 euros per person.

entries.source: Posso pagar os 78 euros com cartão?
entries.reference: Can I pay the 78 euros by card?

entries.source: Quanto custa o autocarro do aeroporto para 2 pessoas?
entries.reference: How much is the airport shuttle for 2 people?

entries.source: O menu do dia custa 15 euros com bebida incluída.
entries.reference: The menu of the day is 15 euros with a drink included.

entries.source: A morada é Calle Mayor 15, terceiro andar.
entries.reference: The address is Calle Mayor 15, third floor.

entries.source: O meu hotel fica na Gran Vía 28, perto do metro.
entries.reference: My hotel is at 28 Gran Vía, near the metro.

entries.source: A embaixada fica no Paseo de la Castellana 259.
entries.reference: The embassy is at Paseo de la Castellana 259.

entries.source: Por favor, anote a morada: número 42, apartamento 5B.
entries.reference: Please write down the address: number 42, apartment 5B.

entries.source: O ponto de encontro é a Plaza del Sol, porta 3.
entries.reference: The meeting point is Plaza del Sol, gate 3.

entries.source: É este o caminho para Carrer de Balmes 112?
entries.reference: Is this the way to Carrer de Balmes 112?

entries.source: Onde fica a paragem de autocarro mais próxima?
entries.reference: Where is the nearest bus stop?

entries.source: Vire à esquerda no semáforo e depois siga em frente 200 metros.
entries.reference: Turn left at the traffic lights, then go straight for 200 meters.

entries.source: É possível ir a pé da estação para o hotel?
entries.reference: Is the station within walking distance of the hotel?

entries.source: Qual linha vai para o aeroporto, a linha 5 ou a linha 8?
entries.reference: Which line goes to the airport, line 5 or line 8?

entries.source: Desculpe, este é o lugar 14A?
entries.reference: Excuse me, is this seat 14A?

entries.source: Como chego à cidade velha daqui?
entries.reference: How do I get to the old town from here?

entries.source: O museu fica a cerca de 15 minutos a pé da praça.
entries.reference: The museum is about 15 minutes on foot from the square.

entries.source: Por favor, chame uma ambulância, alguém está inconsciente.
entries.reference: Please call an ambulance, someone is unconscious.

entries.source: Perdi o meu passaporte e a minha carteira.
entries.reference: I have lost my passport and my wallet.

entries.source: Onde fica o hospital ou a clínica mais próxima?
entries.reference: Where is the nearest hospital or clinic?

entries.source: Sou alérgico a amendoim; este prato contém algum?
entries.reference: I am allergic to peanuts; does this dish contain any?

entries.source: Alguém roubou a minha bolsa com 200 euros dentro.
entries.reference: Someone stole my bag with 200 euros inside.

entries.source: Chame a polícia, por favor. Houve um acidente.
entries.reference: Call the police, please. There has been an accident.
